<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">&#091;English Translation of the Board of Corporate Auditors&#146; Report Originally Issued in the Japanese
Language&#093;
</DIV>
<DIV align="left">
<A name="C18165316"></A>
</DIV>

<DIV align="center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><U><B>Board of Corporate Auditors&#146; Report</B></U>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">Regarding the execution of duties by the Directors for the 142nd Fiscal Year from April&nbsp;1, 2010 to
March&nbsp;31, 2011, we have prepared this Audit Report upon deliberation based on the audit reports
prepared by each Corporate Auditor and hereby report as follows:
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">1.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Auditing Methods Employed by the Corporate Auditors and Board of Corporate Auditors and
Details of Such Methods</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 4%">We established auditing policies, allocation of duties and other relevant matters, and received
reports from each Corporate Auditor regarding their execution of audits and results thereof, as
well as reports from the Directors, other relevant personnel, and the Accounting Auditor
regarding execution of their duties, and sought explanations as necessary.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 4%">Each Corporate Auditor complied with the auditing standards of Corporate Auditors established by
the Board of Corporate Auditors, followed the auditing policies, allocation of duties, and other
relevant matters, communicated with such as the Directors, the Internal Auditing Department and
other employees, and made efforts to establish the environment for collecting department
information and auditing, and participated in the meetings of the Board of Directors and other
important meetings, received reports from such as the Directors and employees regarding execution
of their duties, sought explanations as necessary, examined important authorized documents and
associated information, and studied the operations and status of assets at the head office and
principal offices. In addition, concerning the content of the resolution of the Board of
Directors concerning the maintenance of the systems necessary to ensure that the execution of
duties by the Directors as described in the Business Report complies with laws and regulations
and the Articles of Incorporation, and other systems necessary to ensure the properness of
operations of a Stock Company stipulated in Article&nbsp;100, Paragraph&nbsp;1 and Paragraph&nbsp;3 of the
Ordinance for Enforcement of the Corporation Act; and concerning the systems that are maintained
based on such resolutions (Internal Control Systems): reports were regularly received from
Directors and employees and others regarding the status of establishment and operation, and when
necessary, explanation was sought and opinions were expressed. With respect to subsidiaries, we
communicated and exchanged information with Directors and Corporate Auditors of subsidiaries, and
received reports with respect to their business from subsidiaries as necessary. Based on the
above methods, we examined the Business Report and supplementary schedules thereof for this
fiscal year.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 4%">Furthermore, we monitored and verified whether the Accounting Auditor maintained its independence
and implemented appropriate audits, and we received reports from the Accounting Auditor regarding
the execution of its duties and sought explanations as necessary. In addition, we received notice
from the Accounting Auditor that &#147;the System for ensuring that duties are executed properly&#148;
(matters set forth in each item of Article&nbsp;131 of the Corporate Accounting Regulations) is
organized in accordance with the &#147;Quality Management Standards Regarding Audits&#148; (Business
Accounting Council, October&nbsp;28, 2005) and other relevant standards, and sought explanations as
necessary. Based on the above methods, we examined the non-consolidated statutory report
(&#147;non-consolidated balance sheet,&#148; &#147;non-consolidated statement of income,&#148; &#147;non-consolidated
statement of changes in net assets,&#148; and &#147;notes to non-consolidated statutory report&#148;) and
supplementary schedules thereof, and consolidated statutory report (&#147;consolidated balance sheet,&#148;
&#147;consolidated statement of income,&#148; &#147;consolidated statement of equity,&#148; and &#147;notes to
consolidated statutory report&#148;) for this fiscal year.
</DIV>
<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;

<DIV align="center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><U><B>Reference Materials for the General Meeting of Shareholders</B></U>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left">
<A name="C18165317"></A>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>Proposed Resolution and Reference Information:</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt; background: transparent; color: #000000">
<TR>
    <TD width="7%"></TD>
    <TD width="1%"></TD>
    <TD></TD>
</TR>
<TR valign="top">
    <TD nowrap align="left"><B>Item&nbsp;1:</B></TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left"><B>Appropriation of Surplus</B></DIV></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">The Company is building a sound financial position and flexible and agile corporate strength to
increase its corporate value. Concerning cash dividends to shareholders, the Company continues to
maintain the policy of redistributing profits by considering consolidated business results to
strive to continue stable dividends. Specifically, the Company has set the goal of a consolidated
payout ratio of 20% or higher, and maintains the policy of not decreasing dividends, as long as a
consolidated payout ratio does not surpass 40%.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; text-indent: 4%">For the 142nd fiscal year, the Company proposes to pay a year-end dividend of surplus as
follows, in consideration of the Company&#146;s business performance for the fiscal year and future
business development.
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">(1)</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Type of the dividend assets</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 4%">Cash
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">(2)</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Matters concerning allotment and total amount of the dividend assets</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 4%">JPY 20 per one (1)&nbsp;common share of the Company (an increase of JPY 12 per one (1)&nbsp;common share
of the Company over the previous fiscal year)<BR>
<BR>
Total amount of the dividend assets: JPY 19,369,097,520
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">(3)</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Effective date of dividends of surplus</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 4%">Thursday, June&nbsp;23, 2011
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; text-indent: 4%">Accordingly, combined with the interim dividend of JPY 18 per one (1)&nbsp;common share of the
Company, the annual dividend will be JPY 38 per one (1)&nbsp;common share of the Company for this fiscal
year, an increase of JPY 22 per one (1)&nbsp;common share of the Company over the previous fiscal year.
The consolidated payout ratio is 24%.
</DIV>

    <TD nowrap align="left"><B>Item&nbsp;2:</B></TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: justify"><B>Election of Ten (10)&nbsp;Directors</B></DIV></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">The terms of office of all of the ten (10)&nbsp;Directors will expire as of the close of this Ordinary
General Meeting of Shareholders.
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 4%">Accordingly, the Company proposes that ten (10)&nbsp;Directors be elected.<BR><BR>

The candidates for the positions are as follows:
</DIV>

The Company designated Messrs.&nbsp;Kensuke Hotta, Noriaki Kano and Kouichi Ikeda as Independent
Directors and submitted the notification to the Tokyo Stock Exchange and Osaka Securities
Exchange in accordance with their regulations and related rules.</DIV></TD>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">

<DIV align="center">
<TABLE style="font-size: 10pt" cellspacing="0" border="0" cellpadding="0" width="100%">

<!-- End Table Head -->
<!-- Begin Table Body -->
<TR valign="bottom">
    <TD valign="top"><DIV style="margin-left:0px; text-indent:-0px">Kensuke Hotta
</DIV></TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD align="left" valign="top">Having served as Representative Director of The Sumitomo
Bank, Ltd. (now Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation) and
having experience as Representative Director of Morgan
Stanley Japan Securities Co., Ltd. (now Morgan Stanley MUFG
Securities Co., Ltd.), Mr.&nbsp;Kensuke Hotta has been active
internationally in the financial field and has considerable
insight and profound experience in the business world.</TD>
</TR>
<tr>
<td>&nbsp;</td>
</tr>
<TR valign="bottom" style="padding-top: 1px">
    <TD valign="top"><DIV style="margin-left:0px; text-indent:-0px">&nbsp;
</DIV></TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD align="left" valign="top">Using this insight and experience, his proposals concerning
the overall management of the Company are expected to
contribute to sustaining and improving transparency and
soundness of management and enhancing corporate governance.
Therefore, the Company nominates him as a candidate for
Outside Director.</TD>
</TR>
<TR valign="bottom" style="padding-top: 1px"><!-- Blank Space -->
    <TD valign="top"><DIV style="margin-left:0px; text-indent:-0px">&nbsp;</DIV></TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD align="left" valign="top">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR>
<TR valign="bottom" style="padding-top: 1px">
    <TD valign="top"><DIV style="margin-left:0px; text-indent:-0px">Noriaki Kano
</DIV></TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD align="left" valign="top">Having served as President of the Japanese Society for
Quality Control, Dr.&nbsp;Noriaki Kano has been active
internationally as a specialist of quality control and has
considerable insight and profound experience.</TD>
</TR>
<TR valign="bottom" style="padding-top: 1px">
    <TD valign="top"><DIV style="margin-left:0px; text-indent:-0px">&nbsp;
</DIV></TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD align="left" valign="top">Using this insight and experience, his proposals concerning
the overall management of the Company are expected to pursue
higher &#147;Quality and Reliability,&#148; the Company&#146;s
fundamentals, and enhance corporate value. Therefore, the
Company nominates him as a candidate for Outside Director.</TD>
</TR>
<tr>
<td>&nbsp;</td>
</tr>
<TR valign="bottom" style="padding-top: 1px">
    <TD valign="top"><DIV style="margin-left:0px; text-indent:-0px">&nbsp;
</DIV></TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD align="left" valign="top">The Company judged that although Dr.&nbsp;Noriaki Kano has no
experience in participating in the management of other
companies directly, he would be able to execute the duties
of Outside Director adequately because of the above reasons.</TD>
</TR>

    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Outline of facts pertaining to violations of laws and regulations or the Articles of
Incorporation or facts of any other unjust acts committed at other companies by candidates
for Outside Directors while serving as Director, Executive Officer or Corporate Auditor of
said other companies in the past five (5)&nbsp;years, as well as actions taken to prevent
reoccurrences and respond after occurrence while serving as Outside Directors or Corporate
Auditors of said other companies</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 8%">Sekisui Chemical Co., Ltd., where Dr.&nbsp;Noriaki Kano served as Outside Corporate Auditor until
June&nbsp;2009, received a cease and desist order and a payment order for surcharge from the Japan
Fair Trade Commission in June&nbsp;2007 for violation of Article&nbsp;3 of the Act on Prohibition of
Private Monopolization and Maintenance of Fair Trade on the retail prices of polyethylene gas
pipes and joints for gas companies.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 8%; text-indent: 0%">Dr.&nbsp;Noriaki Kano had been regularly making remarks and promoting awareness about
compliance at the Board of Directors of Sekisui Chemical Co., Ltd., mainly from
customer-oriented point of view. After the facts came to light, he proposed to create an
investigation committee including third parties, as a member of the Board of Corporate
Auditors of Sekisui Chemical Co., Ltd. In addition, he has continued to observe the situations
based on reports on the implementation of preventative measures and requested explanation as
needed.
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">

<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">

    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">When candidates for Outside Directors are currently serving as Outside Director or
Corporate Auditor of the Company, the number of years since they took office</DIV></TD>

management of other companies directly, he would be able to execute the duties of Outside
Corporate Auditor adequately because of the above reasons.

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt"><TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">

<TR valign="top">
    <TD nowrap align="left"><B>Item&nbsp;4:</B></TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left"><B>Payment of Bonuses for Directors</B></DIV></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">Under the Company&#146;s remuneration system for Directors*, the Company proposes to pay bonuses within
the range of JPY 357&nbsp;million in total to the ten (10)&nbsp;Directors who were in office as of the end of
the 142nd fiscal year (of which, JPY 9&nbsp;million in total to the three (3)&nbsp;Outside Directors).
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; text-indent: 0%">The Company requests that the details such as the individual amount and timing of payment to
each Director shall be left to the decision of the Board of Directors.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 0%">*&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;As for the remuneration system for Directors, please refer to &#147;Policy regarding the
determination of remuneration&#148; (p.24).
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt; background: transparent; color: #000000">
<TR>
    <TD width="7%"></TD>
    <TD width="1%"></TD>
    <TD></TD>
</TR>
<TR valign="top">
    <TD nowrap align="left"><B>Item&nbsp;5:</B></TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left"><B>Giving the Board of Directors the Authority to Issue Stock Acquisition Rights as
Stock-Based Remuneration to Employees of the Company and Directors of Major Subsidiaries of
the Company</B></DIV></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">The Company asks for the shareholders&#146; approval to give the Company&#146;s Board of Directors the
authority to issue Stock Acquisition Rights as &#147;stock-based remuneration&#148; to employees of the
Company and Directors of Major Subsidiaries of the Company in accordance with the provisions of
Articles 236, 238 and 239 of the Corporation Act.
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">1.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Reasons for Issuing the Stock Acquisition Rights on Preferential Terms and Conditions</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 4%">The Company would like to grant Stock Acquisition Rights to employees of the Company and to the
Directors of major subsidiaries of the Company without consideration not only for the purposes
of raising their morale and their motivation to contribute to the improvement of the
consolidated performance of the Company, but also for the purpose of clarifying their incentive
to enhance the long-term corporate value of the Company by fostering the same perspective on
corporate value with the shareholders. The number of Stock Acquisition Rights to be granted
without consideration shall be determined based on the Company&#146;s consolidated performance with
the same payment criteria of the &#147;stock-based remuneration&#148; as the Directors of the Company.
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">2.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">The Features and the Maximum Number of the Stock Acquisition Rights that the Board of
Directors Can Decide to Issue under the Authority Granted by a Resolution at this Ordinary
General Meeting of Shareholders</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">(1)</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">The maximum number of the Stock Acquisition Rights for which the terms and conditions of the
issuance can be determined based on the authority granted by this Ordinary General Meeting of
Shareholders</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 4%">The maximum number of Stock Acquisition Rights to be issued under the conditions described in
&#145;2.(3)&#146; below shall be 2,529 units.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 4%; text-indent: 0%">The maximum number of common stocks to be issued upon the exercise of the Stock Acquisition
Rights shall be 252,900 shares, and if the Number of Shares Granted (defined below) subject to
Stock Acquisition Rights is adjusted as provided for in &#145;2.(3)&#146; below, the maximum number of
common stock to be issued shall be the number obtained by multiplying the above mentioned
maximum number of the Stock Acquisition Rights by the adjusted number of shares in connection
with the Stock Acquisition Rights.
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">(2)</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">The Company may issue Stock Acquisition Rights in question without consideration.</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">(3)</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">The features of the Stock Acquisition Rights to be issued on the basis of the authority
granted by this Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="4%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">1)</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Type and number of shares to be issued upon the exercise of Stock Acquisition Rights</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 8%; text-indent: 0%">The shares to be issued for the Stock Acquisition Rights shall be common stock, and the
number of shares subject to one (1)&nbsp;Stock Acquisition Right (&#147;Number of Shares Granted&#148;) shall
be 100 shares. However, after the resolution date of this Item (hereinafter &#147;Resolution
Date&#148;), if the Company effects stock split of its common stock (including allotment of common
stock to shareholders without consideration; the same applies hereinafter) or effects a stock
consolidation, the Number of Shares Granted subject to one (1)&nbsp;Stock Acquisition Right shall
be adjusted proportionately, in accordance with the ratio of the stock split or the stock
consolidation in question.
</DIV>
<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 4%">&nbsp;

<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->51<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

<!-- PAGEBREAK -->
<P><HR noshade><P>
<H5 align="left" style="page-break-before:always"><A HREF="#C18165tocpage">Table of Contents</A></H5><P>

<DIV style="font-family: 'Times New Roman',Times,serif; margin-left: .25in; width: 7.50in">


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 8%">Also, if it is necessary to adjust the Number of Shares Granted after the Resolution Date
for reasons other than the aforementioned reasons, the Company shall adjust the Number of
Shares Granted in connection with the aforementioned Stock Acquisition Rights to the extent
reasonable.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 8%; text-indent: 0%">Fractions of less than one (1)&nbsp;share resulting from the foregoing adjustment shall be
rounded down.
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="4%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">2)</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Amount of assets to be paid upon exercise of the Stock Acquisition Rights</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 8%; text-indent: 0%">The amount of assets to be paid upon exercise of the Stock Acquisition Rights shall be
JPY one (1)&nbsp;per each one (1)&nbsp;share to be transferred upon exercise of the Stock Acquisition
Rights, multiplied by the Number of Shares Granted.
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="4%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">3)</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Exercise period for the Stock Acquisition Rights</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 8%">From August&nbsp;1, 2014 to July&nbsp;31, 2019
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="4%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">4)</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Matters concerning the increase in paid-in capital and capital surplus in the event of
issuance of shares upon the exercise of the Stock Acquisition Rights</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="8%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">i.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">The amount of paid-in capital increase in the event of the issuance of shares upon
the exercise of the Stock Acquisition Rights shall be one half of the maximum amount of
capital increase, calculated in accordance with Article&nbsp;17, Paragraph&nbsp;1 of the Corporate
Accounting Regulations. Fractions less than one (1)&nbsp;yen resulting from the calculation
shall be rounded up.</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="8%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">ii.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">An increase in the capital surplus in the event of the issuance of shares upon
exercise of the Stock Acquisition Rights shall be the amount obtained by subtracting the
amount of the paid-in capital increase from the maximum amount of the capital increase,
as set forth in &#145;4) i&#146; above.</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="4%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">5)</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Restriction on Acquisition of the Stock Acquisition Rights by Transfer</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 8%; text-indent: 0%">Acquisition of the Stock Acquisition Rights by transfer shall be required to be approved
by the resolution of the Board of Directors of the Company.
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="4%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">6)</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Provisions pertaining to acquisition of the Stock Acquisition Rights by the Company</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 8%; text-indent: 0%">The Stock Acquisition Rights do not contain the provisions pertaining to the acquisition
by the Company.
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="4%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">7)</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Conditions for exercising the Stock Acquisition Rights</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 8%; text-indent: 0%">If a holder of Stock Acquisition Rights who is a Director, Corporate Auditor or employee
of the Company, or a Director, Corporate Auditor or employee of an affiliate of the Company,
loses his or her all respective status set above, that person is able to exercise the Stock
Acquisition Rights only within three (3)&nbsp;year period from the date they lost such position;
provided, however, that the period shall not exceed the original exercise period for the Stock
Acquisition Rights described at &#145;3)&#146; above, and the other terms and conditions concerning the
exercise of Stock Acquisition Rights shall be decided by the Board of Directors of the
Company.
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="4%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">8)</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">In the event where the Company engages in any merger (limited to a case where the
Company ceases to exist as the result of the merger), a corporate split in which a division
of the Company is merged into an existing company, a corporate split in which a division of
the Company is spun off to establish a new company (for both, limited to cases where the
Company is split up), or an exchange or transfer of shares (for both, limited to cases
where the Company becomes a fully-owned subsidiary) (hereinafter collectively
&#147;Restructuring Actions&#148;), each person holding the remaining Stock Acquisition Rights at the
time the Restructuring Actions take effect (hereinafter &#147;Remaining Stock Acquisition
Rights&#148;) shall be granted the Stock Acquisition Rights of the relevant stock companies
prescribed in Article&nbsp;236, Paragraph&nbsp;1, Item&nbsp;8, (a)&nbsp;through (e)&nbsp;of the Corporation Act
(hereinafter &#147;Reorganized Company&#148;), in accordance with the conditions set forth below. In
this event, the Remaining Stock Acquisition Rights shall become null and void and new Stock
Acquisition Rights in the Reorganized Company shall be issued. However, the new Stock
Acquisition Rights shall be granted only if provisions for granting them in accordance with
the following conditions (i&#151;viii) are included as conditions in a merger agreement (in
which the Company is merged into a Reorganized Company or a Reorganized Company is
established as the
result of the merger), a corporate split agreement (in which a division of the Company is
merged into a Reorganized Company), a plan for a corporate split (in which a division of the
Company is spun off to establish a Reorganized Company), and a share exchange agreement or a
plan for transfer of shares (in both of which the Company becomes a fully-owned subsidiary of
a Reorganized Company).</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV><P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;

<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->52<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

<!-- PAGEBREAK -->
<P><HR noshade><P>
<H5 align="left" style="page-break-before:always"><A HREF="#C18165tocpage">Table of Contents</A></H5><P>

<DIV style="font-family: 'Times New Roman',Times,serif; margin-left: .25in; width: 7.50in">

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt"><TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">


</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="8%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">i.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Number of the Stock Acquisition Rights of a Reorganized Company to be granted</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 12%">At the time the Restructuring Actions take effect, each holder of the Remaining Stock
Acquisition Rights shall be granted the Stock Acquisition Rights of which the number is
equivalent to the number of such Rights held at the Reorganized Company.
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="8%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">ii.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Type of shares of the Reorganized Company to be issued for the Stock Acquisition
Rights</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 12%">Type of shares subject to the Stock Acquisition Rights shall be common stock of the
Reorganized Company.
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="8%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">iii.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Number of shares of the Reorganized Company to be issued upon exercise of the Stock
Acquisition Rights</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 12%">The number of shares shall be determined in accordance with &#145;1)&#146; above, after taking into
consideration the conditions or other factors concerning the Restructuring Actions.
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="8%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">iv.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Amount of assets to be paid upon the exercise of the Stock Acquisition Rights</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 12%">The amount of assets to be paid upon the exercise of newly granted Stock Acquisition
Rights shall be the amount obtained by multiplying JPY one (1)&nbsp;per each one (1)&nbsp;share, by
the number of shares to be issued for each acquisition right as determined in &#145;8) iii&#146;
above.
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="8%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">v.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Exercise period for the Stock Acquisition Rights</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 12%">The Exercise Period shall begin on either the first date of the exercise period for the
Stock Acquisition Rights stipulated in &#145;3)&#146; above, or on the date that the Restructuring
Actions take effect, whichever comes later, and shall continue to the final date of the
exercise period for the Stock Acquisition Rights stipulated in &#145;3)&#146; above.
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="8%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">vi.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Increase in paid-in capital and capital surplus in the event of the issuance of
 shares upon exercise of the Stock Acquisition Rights<BR>
<BR>

Such increases shall be determined based on &#145;4)&#146; above.</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="8%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">vii.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Restriction on Acquisition of the Stock Acquisition Rights by Transfer</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 12%">Acquisition of the Stock Acquisition Rights by transfer shall be required to be approved
by the Reorganized Company.
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="8%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">viii.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Provisions pertaining to acquisition of the Stock Acquisition Rights</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 12%">The Stock Acquisition Rights do not contain the provisions pertaining to the acquisition
of the Stock Acquisition Rights.
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="4%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">9)</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">In case where the number of shares to be issued or transferred to the holders of the
Stock Acquisition Rights includes any fraction less than one (1)&nbsp;share, such fraction shall
be rounded down.</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">(4)</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: left">Delegation of authority to make decisions regarding the issuance of the Stock Acquisition
Rights and related matters</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 4%">In addition to the above provisions, decisions regarding the issuance of the Stock Acquisition
Rights and all the relevant details shall be decided by the Board of Directors of the Company
which shall be held separately.
</DIV>

<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">End
</DIV>
